baselines.data: All eligible training rows, same24 causal inputs; training-only MinMax01 scaler
baselines.ordinary_mse_selector: Descriptive control from the exhaustive panel: minimum achieved decision-risk upper, then deployment bytes, then lexical ID; frozen before test and not a search-efficiency comparator

certificate.aggregation: Sum disjoint pair SSE minima plus unmatched singleton range floors, divided by full decision cohort N; never double-count floor
certificate.exact_pair_witness: Analytic box-constrained two-point least-squares optimum using80bit distance UPPER endpoint
certificate.no_pair_candidates_action: Return range-only lower withzero exact pair distances
certificate.pair_budget_scope: At most384 exact selected-pair square-root enclosures per triggered target/run; does not bound floating matching work or wall time
certificate.pair_selection: Full floating Euclidean pdist matrix; nearest4 candidates ordered by distance then neighbor query ID then index; unique unordered candidate edges; descending positive clipped-target Lipschitz violation then lexically sorted endpoint query IDs then indices; greedily disjoint
certificate.type: Disjoint-pair range-aware finite-cohort class lower bound

class.metric: Euclidean on frozen median-distance-normalized stored features

data.eligibility: Daily23:00 target calendar; all required lag timestamps and target timestamp must exist, with all3 count columns finite; no zero imputation
data.input_order: Own target's24 consecutive hourly counts ending at origin, oldest to newest
data.target_relation: cnt=casual+registered; these are correlated targets within one dataset, not independent replications
data.test_barrier: All Jul-Dec2012 count values and missingness remain uninterpreted until every model and policy is sealed

execution.failure_rule: Stop and retain partial outcomes; no outcome-driven primary rerun

heads.affine_rule: All-training-row centered ridge; exact coefficient norm check/projection and exact stored-training-mean recentering; range clipping
heads.anchor_rule: equal-row-stratum midpoints in chronological training rows, shared across maps per target
heads.extension_rule: Conservative lower-distance anchor QP, symmetric cone extension and range clipping
heads.unfinished_rule: Retain valid final witnesses; no outcome-driven extra iterations or replacement

pre_freeze_exposure.scope: A metadata-search snippet displayed a few January2011 training rows; values were not used to choose thresholds, origin, models or anticipated outcomes

primary_question: Does a triggered pair certificate avoid additional head fits and reduce actual matched search time relative to ordinary feasibility-plus-cost pruning while preserving the exhaustive threshold/cost choice?

prior.step35_finding: All18 affine heads feasible; zero possible class exclusions atfrozencriterion; ordinary encoder-cost pruning stronger than unnecessary class checks

search.affine_feasible_effect: Disable class-inadequacy certificate only; extension still requires its own valid cost pruning condition
search.class_prune: Verified pair lower>epsilon; retains valid fixed-panel tolerance/cost choice
search.cost_bound: Exact canonical zero-string head template plus known encoder bytes; unknown rational parameter strings have length>=1
search.cost_prune: Strict cost lower bound>current eligible incumbent complete cost; equality never pruned
search.exhaustive: Fit/evaluate every36-head candidate; no pruning; provides canonical proof/evaluation records
search.map_order: Ascending frozen encoder pickle bytes, then map name lexical; available before all head fits
search.ordinary: Common range floor; known encoder+head-template lower payload bound; cheap affine first; update incumbent; recheck extension cost; fit all remaining competitive heads
search.range_floor: Exact average squared distance of unchanged decision targets to I; if>epsilon both ordinary and triggered abstain before head fits
search.triggered: Same ordinary rules; call pair certificate only when affine is not verified eligible, extension remains cost competitive, common range floor does not exclude and call budget remains

selection.cost_excludes: Shared source/runtime code and audit witnesses; includes encoder/reference/scaler/metric state and actual head state
selection.epsilon_recipe: Same as Step35:0.95 times exact normalized training persistence MSE, independently for each target
selection.objective: Minimum complete independently serialized representation+head parameter bytes among eligible heads

success.accuracy_claim: Equal selected head identity gives equal achieved forecast and payload outcomes; any forecast comparison with other predictors remains descriptive
success.consistent_panel_claim: Per-target incremental criterion holds for all3 correlated targets; otherwise report mixed/negative results without broad utility claim
success.per_target_incremental_utility: Triggered avoids strictly more head fits than ordinary AND median paired ordinary-minus-triggered search time is strictly positive, with safety verified
success.safety: Every ordinary and triggered selection/abstention equals canonical exhaustive same-rule choice, on every target and repetition
success.timing_noise_guard: Positive measured time difference without additional avoided head fits is never certificate-specific utility

timing.measurement: Whole in-memory policy execution including actual head refits, exact decision evaluation, payload serialization, hashes, policy bookkeeping and any pair certificate; disk evidence writes occur after clock stops
timing.order: For target index t and paired repetition r starting0, ordinary then triggered if(t+r)even; reversed ifodd
timing.outcome_identity: All repeated head/prediction digests must match canonical exhaustive records after timed execution ends
timing.shared_work: Frozen representation construction, train/decision feature cache, and complete head-template byte-bound construction are performed once per target and reported separately
timing.summary: All5 paired times retained; report median paired ordinary-minus-triggered time and ranges; no iid speedup confidence claim

title: External test of certificate-triggered search beyond feasibility and cost pruning
